app.title: ARCHIVE : FILE-001
app.tagline: You are not restoring a file. You are restoring yourself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.controls.hint: Desktop: point & click, Space to toggle the Memory Layer, Esc to pause. Mobile: tap to interact, dedicated Layer button.
credits.title: Credits
credits.body: ARCHIVE : FILE-001 — a premium browser puzzle-mystery. Milestone 2 vertical slice.
pause.title: Paused
intro.card1: Somewhere in this building is a memory someone chose to forget.
intro.card2: You are the Archivist. Retained, not employed — you don't ask why the fee is this large.
intro.card3: Your task: retrieve FILE-001. Intact. Unread, if you're wise.
intro.card4: The Archive doesn't let files leave undamaged. Neither, it's said, does it let Archivists.
intro.skipHint: Tap or press Esc to skip
prologue.plaque: A brass plaque, worn smooth: "THE ARCHIVE — ALL THAT IS FORGOTTEN IS KEPT."
prologue.inscription: Beneath the plaque, scratched in a hand that might be your own: "You already know the way in."
prologue.doorOpens: The door opens onto a corridor lined with drawers, each one a sealed room of its own.
ch1.exitOpens: The brass key turns. The door gives way onto a corridor that goes further than one room should.
ch1.exitLocked: Sealed. Whatever opens this isn't in your hands yet.
ch1.note: A case note, pinned crooked: "CASE 0231 — DO NOT REPROCESS. Drawer resealed per standard procedure." Someone underlined "do not" twice.

puzzle.drawer.title: SEALED DRAWER
puzzle.drawer.prompt: A four-digit lock. Something in this room remembers the code.
puzzle.drawer.hint1: Something pinned to the evidence board might remember this case.
puzzle.drawer.hint2: Read the note pinned above the drawer.
puzzle.drawer.wrong: The lock doesn't move. Not yet.

term.ch1.status: ARCHIVE STATUS: 1 FILE ACTIVE. INTEGRITY: FRAGMENTED.
term.ch1.search.nitro: UNRELATED RECORD FOUND: VEHICLE FILE — CLASSIFICATION: JOYRIDE. ...this does not belong in this Archive.
notebook.caseCode: Case number, from the pinned note: 0231.
cf.ch1_intake.title: Intake Form — Case 0231
cf.ch1_intake.body2: REASON GIVEN: "I don't want to remember choosing this."
cf.ch1_intake.body3: PROCESSING NOTE: Subject requested confirmation the memory could never be returned. Confirmation given. Subject seemed relieved. — FILING ARCHIVIST: [SIGNATURE ILLEGIBLE]
